metadata.title: Constraining Milky Way mass with Hypervelocity Stars

notes: The paper analyzes the MMT HVS sample statistically, reporting aggregate counts such as the 37 positive-velocity outliers and model-dependent unbound numbers (T:p5-b5, T:p5-b2), but it does not provide individual identifiers for sample stars. The one named star, HD 271791 (T:p5-b5), is cited only as a background example of a hyper-runaway contaminant and is not selected or analyzed as part of this paper's sample; therefore no individual star meets the eligibility criteria.
